mobToHitBase.label: Mob To-Hit Base
mobToHitBase.hint: Floor and attack modifiers are added to this base. Leave blank to seed it from ability and rank.

mobToHitNone.label: No Mob To-Hit
mobToHitNone.hint: This attack has no To-Hit target.

skill.label: Skill
skill.hint: Name of a skill whose base rank replaces this rank.

active.label: Active
active.hint: Its modifiers apply even in the pack (worn items are always active).

gunnerSlot.label: Gunner Slot
gunnerSlot.hint: Vehicle weapons only: which crew slot fires it.

skillName.label: Crew Skill
skillName.hint: Vehicle weapons only: the skill the gunner rolls.

mark.label: Advancement Mark
mark.hint: Set when you use this skill.

isAttack.label: Attack
isAttack.hint: Create a linked Attack when this Skill or Spell is owned by an Actor.

opposedStat.label: Opposed By

enabled.label: Attack Spell
enabled.hint: Also list this spell under Attacks.

ItemSheet.SourceHint: Links this Attack to one owned item using stable Foundry Item IDs.
ItemSheet.LinkedRankHint: Rank is supplied by the linked Skill or Spell. Renaming either item does not break the link.
ItemSheet.PrimarySkillHint: The Skill or Spell whose effective Rank this Attack uses. The Attack ability remains the default ability.
ItemSheet.MissingPrimarySkill: The selected primary Skill or Spell is missing. This Attack uses Rank 0.
ItemSheet.MissingSkill: The selected Skill or Spell is missing. This use rolls at Rank 0.
ItemSheet.UnownedSkillUses: Add this Attack to an Actor before selecting owned Skills or Spells.
ItemSheet.UnownedAttack: Add this Attack to an Actor before linking a source.

Settings.ManaStatHint: The enhanced ability score that sets Max Mana.
Settings.AutoEnableCastHint: Casting a spell turns its skill modifiers on.
Settings.HealthBarOverrideHint: Leave blank for the default: 10 for Crawlers, or the Mob's level (maximum 10). Custom bars can have 1–100 slots.
Settings.ShowRangeInChatHint: Show Range on Attack rolls and Spell casts.
Settings.ShowNotesInChatHint: Show Attack Notes & Effects and Spell Notes & Upgrades on their cards.

GmScreen.Name: GM Screen
GmScreen.Hint: The GM Screen actor that gates floor ends and Level Up for the Crawlers on its roster. Leave blank to turn the integration off.

GmScreen.DropRejected: Only Crawler (PC) world actors can join the GM Screen roster.
GmScreen.UndoBlocked: Can't undo the floor end: {names} already used it (or joined since). Undoing would swallow their next floor end.
GmScreen.UndoRaced: Floor end undone, but {names} ended the floor at the same time and is now ahead of the counter. Check their floor-end cursor.
GmScreen.AddFailed: {name} could not be baselined, so they were not added to the roster. Try again.
GmScreen.BadgeTooltip: The GM has declared a safehouse: Level Up is allowed.
GmScreen.UndoFloorTooltip: Take back the last floor end (−1)
GmScreen.ReadOnly: You can't edit the GM screen.
GmScreen.ConfirmContent: End the floor for: {names}? Each Crawler can then run their own End Floor once.
GmScreen.ConfirmEmpty: The roster is empty. End the floor anyway? Crawlers added later start with no floor ends.
GmScreen.ConfirmUndoContent: Take back the last floor end (−1)? This is refused while any rostered Crawler has already used it.
GmScreen.Inconsistent: This Crawler’s floor-end cursor is ahead of the counter (an End Floor raced an Undo or a re-baseline). Remove and re-add them to re-baseline.
GmScreen.DropHint: Drag Crawler actors here to add them to the roster.
GmScreen.NotConfigured: This GM Screen isn’t selected in the system settings, so it gates nobody.

Advance.Label: Advancement
Advance.EndSessionTooltip: End the session: marked skills and spells at rank 4 or lower roll 1d20 to advance; +1 pending level
Advance.EndFloorTooltip: End the floor: marked skills and spells at rank 5 or higher roll 1d20 to advance; Floor +1
Advance.LevelUpTooltip: Apply a pending level: Level +1, +3 stat points
Advance.UndoTooltip: Undo the last End Session / End Floor

Blocked.NoPending: Level Up needs a pending level — end a session first.
Blocked.Saferoom: Level Up needs a saferoom (Floor 3 or deeper).
Blocked.Safehouse: The GM hasn't declared a safehouse.

Advance.FloorWaiting: Waiting for the GM to end the floor.
Advance.PendingLevelsTooltip: Pending levels (earned at session end, applied with Level Up)
Advance.ConfirmFloorContent: End the floor for {name}? Marked skills and spells at rank 5 or higher roll to advance, and Floor goes up by 1. Undo can revert it.

Defense.EvadeRollTooltip: Roll Evade: 1d20 + Dex Mod + Evade modifiers

Items.MarkTooltip: Advancement mark — set when you use this skill
Items.PostPassiveTooltip: Post this Passive skill without rolling
Items.CastPassiveTooltip: Cast this Passive spell without rolling, spends mana
Items.SkillCheckTooltip: Roll 1d20 against base Rank; equal or higher succeeds

Mob.LevelTooltip: Level sets the Health Bar slot count (1–10)
Mob.Whisper: Whisper Mob rolls to the GM
Mob.WhisperHint: When on, public Mob rolls whisper to the GM. Your selected private roll mode still applies.
Mob.ShowSectionsHint: Hidden sections keep their items and active effects.
Mob.EvadeTooltip: Static Evade target: base + modifiers + Floor
Mob.StaticToHitTooltip: Static To-Hit target: attack base + modifiers + Floor

Vehicle.ConstitutionModifierTooltip: Hit points per Health Bar slot. Blank = 5 (the rulebook vehicle default); a mount uses its own Con Mod
Vehicle.DriveSkillTooltip: The skill the Driver / Rider rolls, e.g. Driving, Riding, Chopper Pilot
Vehicle.ArmorTooltip: Vehicle DR protects the occupants, not the vehicle
Vehicle.RuleSize: Advantage if it is 2+ size classes larger than the attacker; Disadvantage if 2+ smaller
Vehicle.RuleVehicle: Vehicles don't Evade · DR protects occupants · a near miss hits the vehicle
Vehicle.RuleMount: Riders take -3 to non-Riding rolls · mounts act independently (1 Move + 1 Any)
Vehicle.AdvantageTooltip: Roll option for the Driving check and Race / Chase (Ram always rolls at Disadvantage)
Vehicle.TargetLargerTooltip: The target is a larger size class than this vehicle
Vehicle.DealtTooltip: Type the damage rolled, then Apply
Vehicle.ApplyRamTooltip: Self-damage into the Health Bar (no DR) and reduce Speed: vs same size or smaller half damage, Speed halved; vs larger full damage, Speed 0
Vehicle.DamageResistanceAbsorbedTooltip: The vehicle loses one Health Bar slot whenever its DR reduced damage to an occupant
Vehicle.CrewEmpty: No crew. Drag a Crawler or Mob from the Actors sidebar onto this sheet.

Card.RamAftermath: vs same size or smaller: self 50% damage, Speed halved · vs larger: full damage, Speed 0 · occupants take half minus their DR and vehicle DR
Card.RaceGm: GM racers assume a 10 (+5 in round 1 instead of Advantage)

Reject.vehicle: {name} is a vehicle and can't crew one.
Reject.type: {name} can't crew a vehicle: only a Crawler or Mob can.
Reject.notWorld: {name} can't crew a vehicle: drag the actor from the Actors sidebar (unlinked token and compendium actors can't crew).

Unresolved.Label: ⚠ Unresolved modifiers:
Unresolved.Tooltip: These modifiers target nothing on this actor and were not applied.

Inventory.ChooseItemType: Choose the type of item to add.
Inventory.SlotConflict: Another item fills this slot on the paper doll; this one still counts as worn (active)
Inventory.NoAccessories: No accessories. Tick Accessory on an active item.
Inventory.ActiveTooltip: Active: this item's effects apply even in the pack (worn items are always active)
Inventory.AccessoryTooltip: Accessory: listed under Accessories while the item is active
